class.name: UZUPaletteDither
class.brief_description: Palette quantization with ordered dithering for the U.ZU look, as a compositor effect.
class.description: Reduces the colors to [member levels] steps per channel and breaks the bands with a 4x4 Bayer pattern, for a "modern retro" finish. Compositor effects run before tonemapping, so the colors are quantized in a display-like gamma space (1/2.2) and converted back. [method quantize] returns what the effect does to a color at a pixel, so the result can be checked without rendering. [b]Note:[/b] Runs only on RenderingDevice renderers (Forward+ and Mobile) with a 16-bit float color buffer. It does nothing in the Compatibility renderer. [b]Note:[/b] This class is specific to U.ZU Engine.

method.name: get_dither_threshold
method.description: Returns the Bayer threshold of the screen [param pixel], in [code][-0.5, 0.5)[/code]. The pattern tiles every 4 dither cells of [member dither_scale] pixels.

method.name: quantize
method.description: Returns [param color] as the effect outputs it at the screen [param pixel] (the shader uses the same formula). Alpha is kept.

members.member: Screen pixels per dither cell (1 to 8). Bigger values make a chunkier, more visible pattern.
How much the Bayer pattern shifts the rounding: 0 gives plain bands, 1 a full step of dithering.
Steps per color channel (2 to 64). 6 gives 216 colors.
